presets.name: pov 연출
presets.instruction: Show the scene through the persona's eyes, maintaining their eye level, gaze direction, and viewing distance. Never switch to an external or another actor's viewpoint. In the persona's pose description, include only visible hand and arm actions in the current image or panel, including contact, support, or object handling. Keep these actions consistent with the first-person view; leave the description empty when no hands or arms are visible or no action needs clarification. Do not describe the persona's face, appearance, clothing, whole-body pose, or unseen body parts. Frame other present actors and their interactions clearly within a plausible field of view.

presets.name: 다인 연출
presets.instruction: Compose all actors confirmed present at the depicted time and place together, including quiet observers and non-human participants. Preserve established presence within a continuous scene unless departure is indicated. Widen the view or adjust spacing and depth to keep everyone distinguishable and interactions readable. Do not split the scene solely because of actor count, combine separate scenes, or add participants based only on mentions or candidate records.

presets.name: 카툰 연출
presets.instruction: Render each requested illustration as one coherent manga page. Let the scene's action, emotion, timing, and reveal drive bold variation in panel scale, shape, overlap, camera, focus, spacing, and visual hierarchy instead of defaulting to a uniform row, column, stack, or grid. Panels and Actors may break, overlay, or span boundaries when that strengthens the presentation. Keep the reading flow unmistakable even when the page is asymmetric, layered, or non-linear. Use only as many meaningful panels as the scene needs, and do not force color or monochrome treatment.
